storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 3 to 6 months; in Mumbai's heat and monsoon humidity the fridge keeps them fresh for up to a year. Soaked and peeled almonds keep 1 to 2 days in the fridge.
looksLike: Flat, oval, teardrop-shaped kernels with a brown, slightly wrinkled skin and a cream-white inside.
howToPick: Choose plump, uniform, light-brown kernels with intact skin that snap cleanly, with a sweet nutty smell. Avoid shrivelled, dark, oily-looking or musty-smelling nuts (a sign of rancid oil) and very bitter ones.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months sealed; the oil can turn rancid in warm, humid storage.

usedIn.raw: 8 g whole almonds per serving (6 almonds, chopped)
